column1: # Fitbit Web API: vendor fields to LOINC 2.83
# Fitbit Web API response fields. Two sleep log modes (classic, stages), a skin temperature that is
# a deviation from baseline, and active-zone minutes that double-count cardio and peak minutes.
#   Per-endpoint response tables; Fitbit publishes no OpenAPI document.
#   type        the vendor's data type, record class or endpoint, verbatim
#   field       the field inside it, verbatim; empty when the type is the reading
#   metric      the mirobody catalogue name (res/catalog/metrics.tsv); empty when the catalogue has no row
#   loinc       the LOINC code the field means; EMPTY IS A DECLINE, and the note says why
#   confidence  confident = the six LOINC axes agree with the vendor's definition;
#               unverified = close, a person must confirm before a reading is filed under it
#   note        the reasoning; some notes are in Chinese, as they were written
# Every code was checked by hand against the LOINC 2.83 axis table on 2026-09-09.
# No vendor API carries a LOINC code of its own. LOINC is copyright Regenstrief
# Generated from the maintainers' review tables; edit through a pull request,
# and keep the file loadable by mirobody.translate.devices.

字段文档原文 "Root Mean Square of Successive Differences (RMSSD)"，ms。LOINC 无 RMSSD 码
深睡期间 RMSSD；同上无码。本仓 `sleepHeartRateRMSSD` 正好对应
Fitbit 是四区（Out of Range / Fat Burn / Cardio / Peak），本仓五区，LOINC 三区+最大区，三方档位互不对齐，不落码
1 分钟 SpO2 的日均；日均口径亦可用 103209-3（但该码 PROPERTY=NRat 有缺陷，(see docs/device-crosswalk.md)
LOINC 无日最低/最高血氧码（59405-7/59406-9 是 8 小时窗）
average number of breaths taken per minute，睡眠期间均值。`103217-6` Mean respiratory rate 的 SCALE_TYP 为空、CLASS 误置，(see docs/device-crosswalk.md)
绝对温度（°C/°F 随 Accept-Language）
陷阱：这是相对基线的偏差，不是绝对皮温。绝不可落到 `61008-9` / `8310-5`。LOINC 无相对温差码。另有 `logType` = dedicated_temp_sensor / other_sensors，可作数据质量分层
文档单位 mL/kg/min（与本仓 mL/min/kg 同义异序）。Fitbit 是估算值，非 CPET，故 unverified
Fitbit `duration` 是睡眠日志总长（ms），含清醒段 → 近「卧床时长」。须核是否等于 timeInBed
LOINC 无睡眠效率码（轴表 Sleep efficiency 0 命中）
Sleep duration

Duration of falling asleep
Duration in bed

Fitbit 有两套睡眠模式：`classic`（restless/asleep/awake，无分期）与 `stages`（deep/light/rem/wake）。classic 日志无法落分期码，只能落总睡眠时长。归一化时必须按 logType 分流
数据质量码（0 充分 / 1 心率数据不足 / 2 睡眠短于 3 小时 / 3 服务端问题）。建议接进本仓的置信分级而不是丢弃
陷阱：AZM 的 cardio 与 peak 区按 2 倍计（文档原文「1 cardio minute = 2 cardio active zone minutes」），是加权分而非真实分钟数,与任何 LOINC 时长码不可比
同上（fat burn 为 1 倍）
